seo.title: Referral program: €300 to €600 per referral | Soliance
seo.description: Recommend Soliance to someone you know: a €300 to €600 bonus by bank transfer when their installation goes live, then a weekend for two at the 5th referral.

hero.title: You recommend us. We thank you, in euros.
hero.lead: Someone close to you signs up for an installation with Soliance thanks to you? You receive a bonus as soon as it goes live, and it grows with every new referral. No time limit.
hero.imageAlt: Two neighbors chat over a hedge, one pointing at the panels on his roof

shareContact.title: You send us a contact
shareContact.description: Through the form below, by phone or from your customer area. With their consent.

callWithin48Hours.title: We call them within 48 hours
callWithin48Hours.description: Free assessment, appointment, quote: the same journey as yours.

signAndInstall.title: They sign and get their installation
signAndInstall.description: Solar, heat pump or charging station: every installation counts.

receiveReward.title: You receive your bonus
receiveReward.description: By bank transfer, within 30 days of the installation going live.

conditions.title: Terms
conditions.text: Reserved for Soliance and Soliance Care customers. The referred person must not already be in contact with Soliance. The bonus is due when the referred person's installation goes live and is paid by bank transfer. The referral rank is calculated across all of the referrer's successful referrals, with no time limit. The weekend for two is given as a gift box, indicative value available on request. The program may change; the applicable terms are those in force on the date the contact is sent.

form.title: Refer someone
form.consent: I confirm that the person I am referring agrees to be contacted by Soliance about their project.
form.refereeNotice: By entering the details of someone close to you, you confirm that you have told them about this referral and obtained their agreement to be contacted by Soliance.
form.successDescription: Thank you! We will call the person you referred within 48 hours. Your bonus is paid by bank transfer within 30 days of their installation going live.
